request.situation: We rent a flat in Helsinki and plan to move to Tampere in spring. How do we end the rental agreement and what is the notice period?

title: Terminating your rental agreement and moving out

evidence.quote: When the tenant terminates the lease, the period of notice is one month.
For a tenant, the notice period is always one calendar month.

Submit a notification of change of address(external link) to Posti and the Digital and Population Data Services Agency (DVV) no earlier than one month before and no later than one week after the move.
